Frequently asked questions

What is voice typing?

Voice typing means writing with your voice instead of your keyboard. You speak, and Granola turns your speech into text where you're typing.

Is voice typing the same as dictation?

Yes. Dictation and voice typing both describe speaking to enter text. Voice-to-text describes the technology that converts your speech into written words.

Do I have to write inside Granola?

No. Voice typing puts your words directly into the app you're using, whether that's an email, Slack message, Google Doc or prompt for Claude.

How is this different from meeting notes?

Meeting notes capture a conversation. Voice typing helps you write your own messages, prompts and documents by speaking into the app where you want the text.

Is voice typing free?

Yes. Voice typing is free for all Granola users, including users on the Basic plan.

Which devices can I use it on?

Voice typing is available on Mac, Windows and iOS. Android support is coming soon.
